Fixes #17286 and cleans up some code quality issues.

Note that #17222 has not been merged to bleed yet, so the 5th-paratrooper-dies bug is still present and not related to this PR.
pr_comments: It doesn't, although some of the fixes in this could perhaps also be made there. This would need to be a separate PR.

issue_context.title: Pilots spawned from aircraft killed above water freeze in the air
comments: This is actually not exclusive to spawning above water. The same thing happens when the aircraft is killed above land. It seems actors spawned upon death do not parachute or perform any kind of initial activity at all (normal paratroopers work fine). When this happens above land, they will glitch to their proper ground position before performing a move order. When above water, they are stuck as they obviously cannot path through water.

review_comments: Shouldn't we skip actor creation if `!Info.AllowUnsuitableCell` and `subCell == SubCell.Invalid`?

We do, several lines above this. This line here can therefore assume that the cell has the correct terrain type and a free subcell, so we can bypass the missing plumbing in `IPositionableInfo` and query the subcell from the `ActorMap` directly.
I see, this is just to make sure we don't use `SubCell.Invalid` if we allow unsuitable cells.
If there are no free cells and `Info.AllowUnsuitableCell` is true we want infantry to drop into the middle of the cell before they are squished.
